qa: No, even if this effect didn't suspend the target, it can still give it "can't unsuspend."

text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text: ＜Vortex＞ ＜Decode ([Aegiomon])＞ [On Play] [When Digivolving] Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers. It can't unsuspend until their turn ends. Then, if you have 3 or fewer security cards, this Digimon gains ＜Piercing＞ and +5000 DP for the turn. (Rule) Trait: Has [Vegetation] Type.

text_sections.label: Inherited Effect
text_sections.text: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When your security stack is removed from, you may suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers.
